title: Music Note
body:
The Music Note is a logic component that can be purchased from Alan's AutoLogistics. It can play back a single musical note.

Functionality

The Music Note plays a single note whenever a signal greater than 0 is applied to it. The signal sent to the Music Note determines the pitch that the note is played back at, with a maximum pitch at a signal value of 25. The Music Note does not sustain its note, and must have a signal constantly pulsed to it in order to approximate sustaining a note.

The instrument that the Music Note uses can be cycled by interacting with it. However, there is no indication as to what instrument is selected. The instruments are selected from the list as follows, wrapping around after the last instrument is selected:

  • Piano
  • Violin
  • Brass
  • Xylophone
  • Woodblock
  • Timpani
  • Guitar

Trivia

  • This item was previously named "NoteSoundComponent" and had an appearance more reminiscent of the Note Blocks from Minecraft.
